name: Documents and notes
description: Finds the person's own Drive, Notion and Kriya documents, answers from them with exact references, and says when the answer isn't there.
prerequisites: Google Drive or Notion connected in Account, or files in Kriya
verification: Each answer quotes the document it came from and where in it; nothing is changed by this skill.
